verdict.rationale: Teller is a financial-data API, and data portability is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no first-party export-all or account-exit feature in open formats. The only export evidence is a community-built script that turns API data into CSV/QIF, which is a user-side workaround built on developer building blocks (the transactions and balances APIs). Sidecar is about switching to Teller, not leaving it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: I built a little script to export my accounts to CSV/QIF.
The transactions API exposes the ledger transactions of a financial account.
